groundTruth.description: The Favorites view must not recommend opening the Favorites view itself.

hypotheses.title: The 'Abrir meus favoritos' button is not functional.
hypotheses.observedEvidence: The button labeled 'Abrir meus favoritos' appears to be inactive or unclickable, as it does not change state upon interaction and there are no visible loading indicators.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: When the user clicks on the 'Abrir meus favoritos' button, a modal should appear displaying saved favorites.
hypotheses.oracle: The button should visually change state (e.g., become highlighted or have an animation) and trigger a modal to open when clicked.

hypotheses.title: The 'Explorar a vitrine' button is not functional.
hypotheses.observedEvidence: The button labeled 'Explorar a vitrine' appears to be inactive or unclickable, as it does not change state upon interaction and there are no visible loading indicators.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: When the user clicks on the 'Explorar a vitrine' button, it should navigate them to a new page or section showcasing featured products.
hypotheses.oracle: The button should visually change state (e.g., become highlighted or have an animation) and trigger navigation when clicked.

hypotheses.title: The 'Favoritos' tab in the bottom navigation bar is not functional.
hypotheses.observedEvidence: The 'Favoritos' tab appears to be inactive, as it does not change state upon interaction and there are no visible loading indicators or navigational cues.
hypotheses.expectedBehavior: When the user clicks on the 'Favoritos' tab in the bottom navigation bar, they should be directed to a page displaying their saved favorites.
hypotheses.oracle: The tab should visually change state (e.g., become highlighted or have an animation) and trigger navigation when clicked.

reviews.title: The 'Abrir meus favoritos' button is not functional.
reviews.reason: There are no visible loading indicators, but the button does not visually change state upon interaction. This suggests it might be disabled or inactive rather than unfunctional.
reviews.suggestedOracle: Check if there's a JavaScript function that handles this button and verify its status in the console.
